subject: GROUP INDICATE clause
notes: kb/Work PB1244 (w66j). cite.py --check 13.18.28.4 'true only on the first occasion that a GENERATE is issued for the current detail group' OK 1). GROUP INDICATE is now what GR1 says: a PRESENT WHEN on the item whose condition is PER DETAIL GROUP. ArmGroupIndicate sets every detail's GroupIndicatePending at INITIATE (a), PageFeed (b) and a detected control break (c); GenerateCore clears the GENERATEd detail's flag after its presentation (its own page-fit advance re-arms first); PresentBody publishes it as GroupIndicatePresent and the emitter ANDs it into the item's presence test with PRESENT WHEN and OCCURS DEPENDING (§13.18.63.4 GR22), so a non-presented indicated item is absent (§13.18.41.4 GR2b) - no column, no horizontal-counter move, and a relative COLUMN operand is automatic (COBOL0899 report-indicate-relative-column retired). Golden pb1244_group_indicate_per_detail_group witnesses all three defects the 14d verdict named (a second detail group's first GENERATE; a non-indicated item on another line under the same columns; relative COLUMN before and after an indicated item) and all three events. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.Reports.cs#BindReportEntry (kb/Work PB1244 deleted the report-wide _indicateFresh flag and the per-group IndicateFields column mask (EmitReportConstruction no longer registers spans, PresentLine no longer blanks, BindReportEntry no longer stages the relative-COLUMN refusal);
